text: Embedding ethical governance in personal AI systems states that personal AI can offer privacy and autonomy while shifting ethical, legal, and governance responsibility from organizations to individual users. This qualifies Kaal's individual-accountability design by identifying responsibility transfer as a burden as well as a governance mechanism. The abstract does not establish that individual allocation is fair, enforceable, or sufficient.
